svg.title: 3D Campus Tour — architecture
svg.desc: 3D Campus Tour: Browser 3D campus explorer · Three.js · Express · MongoDB. Not everyone can visit a campus in person. This tour lets visitors walk through 3D models of campus locations in the browser and open hotspots that explain what they are looking at, with nothing to install.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Full 3D models feel more real than flat photos, but each .glb must

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: download before its scene appears and uses GPU memory. The app

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: frees the previous model on every switch: memory stays flat, but
